lcc_original: 永恆主說：『人類旣是屬肉體的，我的靈就不永遠住在人類裏面：他在世的日子可以活到一百二十歲。』
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of YHWH (WH03068); maps cleanly to UNV's 耶和華
WAH01931 (הוּא, pronoun 'he') placed on 人類 — LCC expands the pronoun reference explicitly to 人類 (human kind), parallel to UNV's 人
旣 in LCC corresponds to UNV's 既 (same character, traditional/simplified variant), both rendering בְּשַׁגַּם (WAH09002+WH01571+WTH8677)
是 before 屬肉體的 is a Chinese copula added by LCC for grammatical flow, not tagged; WH01320 (בָשָׂר flesh) attached to 是屬肉體的 as a unit
在世 in 他在世的日子 is LCC's explanatory expansion ('days in the world') with no Hebrew root; WH03117 (יוֹם day) covers the whole phrase
歲 (age/year) is LCC's word where UNV uses 年; both map to WH08141 (שָׁנָה year)
UNV's 然而 (discourse connector, no SN) is replaced by a colon in LCC — no SN impact
